image.description: [Grocy](https://github.com/grocy/grocy) is an ERP system for your kitchen! Cut down on food waste, and manage your chores with this brilliant utility.  Keep track of your purchases, how much food you are wasting, what chores need doing and what batteries need charging with this proudly Open Source tool  For more information on grocy visit their website and check it out: https://grocy.info

changelog.desc: Rebase to Alpine 3.21. Add php-opcache package.
Rebase to Alpine 3.20. Existing users should update their nginx confs to avoid http2 deprecation warnings.
Add `clear_env = no` to `php-fpm` to pass on environment variables to workers threads
Existing users should update: site-confs/default.conf - Cleanup default site conf.
Rebasing to alpine 3.15 with php8. Restructure nginx configs ([see changes announcement](https://info.linuxserver.io/issues/2022-08-20-nginx-base)).
Update docs to reflect jenkins builder changes.
Switching to new Base images, shift to arm32v7 tag.

ports.desc: will map the container's port 80 to port 9283 on the host

image.title: Grocy
image.setup_instructions:
Grocy is simple to get running. Configure the container with instructions below, start it, and you can then access it
by visiting http://your.ip:9283 - once the page loads, you can log in with the default username and password of admin / admin

### Upgrading

Following a container upgrade ensure that you visit the root (`/`) route (click on the logo in the left upper edge) in order to run any necessary database migrations. See [https://github.com/grocy/grocy#how-to-update](https://github.com/grocy/grocy#how-to-update) for more details.

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  grocy:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/grocy:latest
    container_name: grocy
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/grocy/config:/config
    ports:
      - 9283:80
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=grocy \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 9283:80 \
  -v /path/to/grocy/config:/config \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/grocy:latest
